preconditions.description: The number of elements in the array must be between 1 and 200,000.
The maximum number of operations must be between 1 and 200,000.
The integer x must be a positive integer between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element of the array must be within the range of -1,000,000,000 to 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: all(b_i % x == a_i % x for a_i, b_i in zip(a, b))
postconditions.description: Each element of the output array must be congruent to the corresponding input element modulo x.
The output array must have the same length as the input array.

postconditions.expression: sum(1 for i in range(n) if b[i] != a[i]) <= k
postconditions.description: The number of modified elements in the output array must not exceed k.
